title: Normalized identity evaluation is independent of complex models
statement: Let X be a scheme with a derived category D of its module sheaves. Use the fixed internal-Hom and tensor models of [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-model] and explicit uncurrying of [lem-pc-tensor-hom-uncurry-differential]. For arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes L,M define E(L,M): RHom(QL,QM) tensor QL -> QM by the tensor of the Hom resolution isomorphism with identity on QL, followed by the tensor model comparison for Hom(L,I(M)) and L, followed by the localization of explicit uncurrying at the identity of Hom(L,I(M)), followed by the inverse resolution augmentation of M. For any L,M,Lprime,Mprime with literal equalities QL=QLprime and QM=QMprime, E(L,M) and E(Lprime,Mprime) are heterogeneously equal after these object equalities. There is no P, no arbitrary input morphism phi and no K-flatness hypothesis in this statement.

proof.text: Apply the existing localized evaluation naturality square to the equality isomorphisms eqToIso hL and eqToIso hM. Abstract the four derived objects and the two evaluation arrows. Equality induction on these abstract objects reduces both equality isomorphisms to identities. The pair of identities is the identity of the product category; functor map_id, tensor identities and composition identities reduce the square to equality of the evaluations. Convert this equality to HEq. Equality induction is performed on derived objects, not on the source complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorHomIdentityEvaluation_coherence (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (L M L' M' : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hL : DerivedCategory.Q.obj L = DerivedCategory.Q.obj L')
    (hM : DerivedCategory.Q.obj M = DerivedCategory.Q.obj M') :
    letI := schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal X
    HEq (((schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L M).hom ⊗ₘ
          𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) ≫
        pullbackTensorModelMap X _ L ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X _ L M (𝟙 _)) ≫
            schemeHomResolutionInverse X M)
      (((schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L' M').hom ⊗ₘ
          𝟙 (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L')) ≫
        pullbackTensorModelMap X _ L' ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X _ L' M' (𝟙 _)) ≫
            schemeHomResolutionInverse X M')
